story.body: You saw the three baskets and the hamper corded, and the trestles left as the inn's. Thirteen and four went onto the sill and into the host's hand. The ostlers gave Sam his cues from the hay-loft. You walked out behind the cart with Nick, and the eightpence was not paid in the yard.

title: Cleared the winter house at the Cross Keys

participation.context: Answered Nick without a measurement, and left the nine lines uncut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Paid the eightpence and told the yard not to be looked at.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Turned both locks, and would not copy a joke twice.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Asked the breadth, and did not look back.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.name: Sam Latchet

relations.quote: Is this stage truly twice the breadth of the inn's?

story.body: You reached the Theatre behind the cart, heard the eightpence paid, and refused Nick a width you had not walked. You did not look back. The books went under the stage in Garnish's chest. You told them the nine lines are still in your own hand at home, and that you have not cut any yet.

title: Heard the eightpence paid at the Theatre door
